name: Kodama of the West Tree
description: A towering tree kami who lets Eiko and Kaito pass along the border of Jukai Forest as long as they do not cross the river.

description_citations.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
description_citations.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Eiko speaks with the Kodama of the West Tree and gains safe passage but conceals the threat of Tameshi.
timeline.quote: "She says we can pass through safely, as long as we don't go beyond the river,"
